items.name: Central Station
items.description: One of Brussels' main railway hubs, offering convenient connections across the city and direct train services to major destinations throughout Belgium.

items.name: Cathédrale des Saints-Michel-et-Gudule
items.description: The Gothic cathedral of Brussels, seat of the Archdiocese and host to major national ceremonies.

items.name: Royal Palace of Brussels
items.description: The official palace of the King and Queen of the Belgians, used for state functions and royal duties.

items.name: Parc de Bruxelles
items.description: The largest urban park in central Brussels, laid out between the Royal Palace and the Parliament.

items.name: Mont des Arts
items.description: A hilltop garden and viewpoint connecting the lower and upper town, framed by museums and the Royal Library.

items.name: Grand Place
items.description: Brussels' UNESCO-listed central square, lined with ornate guild houses and the Gothic Town Hall.

items.name: Belgian Federal Parliament
items.description: The seat of Belgium's federal legislature, housed in the Palace of the Nation.

items.name: Grand Sablon
items.description: An antiques and chocolate quarter built around a Gothic church, known for its boutiques and cafés.

items.name: Place Royale
items.description: A neoclassical square at the top of the city, home to the Royal Museums of Fine Arts and Église Saint-Jacques-sur-Coudenberg.

items.name: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
items.description: One of Belgium's largest art collections, spanning Old Masters to modern works across several linked museums.

items.name: Magritte Museum
items.description: A museum dedicated to the surrealist painter René Magritte, holding the world's largest collection of his work.

items.name: Palace of Justice
items.description: A monumental 19th-century courthouse, one of the largest buildings constructed anywhere in the world in its era.

items.name: European Commission
items.description: The executive branch of the European Union, headquartered in the Berlaymont building in the European Quarter.

items.name: Bourse (Brussels Stock Exchange)
items.description: Brussels' former stock exchange building, a 19th-century landmark now home to a beer museum and event space.

items.name: Congress Column
items.description: A historic Brussels monument commemorating Belgium’s independence and Constitution, crowned by a statue of King Leopold I and home to the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

items.name: Bus Stop (Parc)
items.description: Bus Lines 29, 63, 65 & 66, offering convenient connections to central Brussels and surrounding neighbourhoods.

items.name: Tram Stop (Parc)
items.description: Tram Lines 92 & 93, offering convenient connections to key areas across central Brussels.

items.name: Metro Station (Parc)
items.description: Metro Lines 1 & 5, providing convenient connections to Brussels city centre, major railway stations and key destinations across the city.

items.name: Train Station (Central Station / Gare Centrale)
items.description: A railway hub in the heart of Brussels, offering local and national train connections, including easy access to Brussels Airport and major Belgian cities.

items.name: Léopold Café Royal
items.description: A welcoming café in Brussels, offering specialty coffee, brunch, bagels, fresh juices, and homemade pastries—perfect for breakfast, lunch, or a coffee break.

items.name: PAUL
items.description: A historic French bakery founded in 1889, offering freshly baked bread, pastries, croissants, sandwiches, and coffee—perfect for breakfast or a quick bite.

items.name: Beat
items.description: A vibrant Belgian restaurant and bar in Brussels, offering Belgian-inspired cuisine, brunch, cocktails, and casual dining in a stylish and welcoming setting.

items.name: Carrefour express Rue des Colonies
items.description: Open Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM–8:00 PM; Saturday & Sunday, 10:00 AM–9:00 PM.

items.name: Carrefour express Brussel Congres
items.description: Open Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–9:00 PM; Saturday & Sunday, 8:00 AM–9:00 PM.

items.name: Belwash
items.description: Convenient self-service laundry facilities. Open daily, 7:00 AM–10:00 PM.

items.name: Onepark – Sainte-Gudule
items.description: A convenient covered car park near Brussels Central Station, offering 24/7 access and a central location.

items.name: Indigo Parking – Parking Royal
items.description: A convenient car park in central Brussels, offering secure parking, EV charging, and easy ticketless access with license plate recognition.

items.name: Street Parking
items.description: Paid on-street parking is available on Rue de Louvain and surrounding streets, subject to local parking regulations and availability.
